status: Prospective conditional length-extension evaluation; no further training
admission: Run only after mac-sana-binary-v1 has completed generation, controls, export, fixed demo and independent audit, with audited_success and integrity_passed both true. All previous model and checkpoint serialization jobs must have exited.
checkpoint: The exact best checkpoint chosen by the unchanged parent development rule; record its full SHA-256 at admission. No weight or sampling changes.
inference: Identical parent one-step sampler, original VAE, input font and raw generated carry crop. The only extension is the number of calls in the supplied right-to-left column schedule. No OCR, solver, candidate selection or output repair in generation.
random_generation: NumPy default_rng; sample LSB-first bit vectors with top bit one for each operand; reject duplicate ordered pairs within each length; keep the first 32 unique pairs.
stage_seed: noise_seed + length*10000 + program_index*1000 + stage; random program indices 0..31, stress indices 100 and 101
readers: Unchanged parent ten-digit template banks and Tesseract 5.5.3, crop [128,300,384,488], psm 7, whitelist 0123456789. Require exactly two binary digits after removing whitespace. No repairs or narrowed whitelist.

gates.program_exactness: A program counts as correct only if every intermediate subtotal and the final answer are numerically correct and every generated output is valid under both unchanged readers.

exclusions: None; malformed outputs and incomplete programs cannot count as correct.

resources.resume: Persist every generated stage and its input/output hashes and seed. On recovery validate the complete saved prefix and continue from its last unaltered carry crop.

claim_boundary: Length extension of visual composition of eight supervised elementary binary facts under a supplied column schedule. Not decimal arithmetic, autonomous algorithm discovery, unseen elementary-fact induction, or evidence that pretraining outperforms scratch training.
